::: pf-aim
PAST-FORWARD is building a GIS-based assessment toolbox and a web-based Decision Support System (DSS) to support data-driven, participatory adaptation planning — developed as part of <a href="work-packages.qmd#wp2">WP2</a>. Releases are listed here as they become available, with no limit on how many appear or how far back they go.
:::
